Download the project's latest release, and extract it where you want the game installed.
Run it: its installer asks for the files you copied, with Add Files for containers or images from the console, and Add Folder for a folder of the game's raw files.
It only accepts unmodified files of one region: a disc and a title update from different regions will not go together.

Baixe a release mais recente do projeto e extraia onde você quiser instalar o jogo.
